name: com.visionforgex.ads
description: Google Ad Manager demand for Unity games through VisionForgeX: rewarded, interstitial, rewarded interstitial, app open and banner ads by placement name, with every decision (what to request, pacing, floors, refresh, consent, experiments) made on apps.visionforgex.com. A thin layer over the VisionForgeX Android SDK 1.2.0 (Google's Next-Gen SDK or Google Mobile Ads 25.x) and iOS SDK 1.2.0 (Google Mobile Ads 13). Placeholder ads in the Editor.

samples.description: A rewarded button, an interstitial between levels, a bottom banner, privacy options and the debug panel. Runs in the Editor with placeholder ads, and on a device with Google's demo ads (test mode) or the platform's.
